newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to ask for WEU help for Great Lakes region.
newsitem.headline: EU to ask for WEU help for Great Lakes region.

text.p: The European Union is set to ask the Western European Union (WEU) formally on Friday to provide air and logistics support for an eventual international humanitarian aid effort in Africa's troubled Great Lakes region.
A formal decision is needed for the EU's fledgling defence arm to act and this is expected to be taken without further discussion at the development Council on Friday, diplomats said.
Earlier this week foreign and defence ministers from the 10-nation defence grouping said the WEU would act if asked to do so.
Whether it actually goes to the Great Lakes region will depend on whether a military planning meeting in the German city of Stuttgart on Friday decides to send in a Canadian-led multinational force.
The decision has been thrown into doubt after the voluntary return to Rwanda of 500,000 of the estimated 1.2 million refugees in eastern Zaire.
The WEU links 10 EU members -- all but Austria, Denmark, Sweden, Ireland and Finland. It has said it is also willing to give financial help to African nations that were helping in the Rwanda crisis.
